tickets.title: Prepare business-sale destination note
tickets.text: Prepare a concise destination note for Raina Bramblequill covering operating cash, reserves, estimated taxes, investment staging, and CPA and attorney questions following her sale of 80% of Cloudberry Kite Design Studio to Silver Marmot Holdings.
tickets.evidence: Raina asked for a concise destination note covering operating cash, reserves, estimated taxes, investment staging, and CPA and attorney questions; the agreed follow-up is due January 10, 2025.

tickets.title: Obtain executed escrow agreement and final working-capital schedule
tickets.text: Obtain the executed escrow agreement and final working-capital schedule missing from Raina Bramblequill’s sale file. Resolve the net proceeds reconciliation discrepancy between the closing binder and bank deposit by identifying escrow, advisory fees, legal fees, and working-capital adjustments.
tickets.evidence: The agreed January 3, 2025 follow-up is to obtain the executed escrow agreement and final working-capital schedule missing from the sale file.
